quarterly_data.quarter: ASUS press release: ASUS Announces New 64GB Configuration of ASUS Ascent GX10 (10-05-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: ASUS announced a new 64GB configuration of the ASUS Ascent GX10 compact AI supercomputer alongside the existing 128GB model, based on the NVIDIA DGX Spark platform: NVIDIA GB10 Grace Blackwell Superchip (Blackwell GPU with fifth-generation Tensor Cores and FP4, 20-core NVIDIA Grace Arm CPU), up to 1 petaflop of FP4 AI performance (with sparsity), 64GB of LPDDR5x coherent unified memory with 273GB/s bandwidth, sized for 30-35-billion-parameter open-source models. Two units can be clustered over built-in NVIDIA ConnectX-7 networking for up to 128GB of unified memory and up to 2 petaflops. ASUS positions it as a lower-cost entry point; no availability date or price is stated.
